Class MainController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Controller.MainController
public class MainController extends Object
Manages a single match: lobby, game start, and action routing. One instance per match; coordinated by MatchRegistry.

  • Method Details

    • joinOrReconnect

      public JoinResult joinOrReconnect(String nickname, ClientHandler clientHandler)
      Joins a player to this match or reconnects them if already known.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      clientHandler - the handler for this client
      Returns:
      the join result with matchId, playerId, and host flag
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if nickname is taken, lobby full, or match in progress with unknown nick

    • completeReconnection

      public void completeReconnection(ClientHandler clientHandler)
      Completes a reconnection by attaching the client to the broadcast and sending it the full snapshot. MUST be called by the transport layer after the JoinResult response has been delivered, so on TCP the snapshot never races ahead of the lobby handshake on the shared stream. No-op if the match is not in game (e.g. a lobby join).
      Parameters:
      clientHandler - the reconnected client's handler

    • restore

      public static MainController restore(MatchSnapshot snap, MatchRegistry registry, PersistenceManager pm)
      Persistence: rebuilds a suspended match from a snapshot after a server restart. The model is reattached to a fresh (empty) ViewUpdater; the match starts with every player marked DISCONNECTED and suspended, waiting for MIN_TO_CONTINUE players to reconnect by nickname before resuming.
      Parameters:
      snap - the loaded snapshot
      registry - the registry that will own the rebuilt controller
      pm - the persistence manager for ongoing saves and cleanup
      Returns:
      the reattached controller, in IN_GAME + suspended state

      Returns:

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Releases per-match resources (FA3 scheduler, FA2 persist executor). Used on game over: queued snapshot writes are dropped because the snapshot is about to be deleted anyway.

    • flush

      public void flush()
      Persistence: ordered shutdown for a still-running match (server stopping). Stops the scheduler and lets the persist executor drain its queue so the last snapshot reaches disk, then waits briefly for it.
